general.q: Is there a minimum contract length?
general.a: No. Every plan is month-to-month with no lock-in and no cancellation penalties. Upgrade, pause, or cancel any time. We earn your business every month through results.

general.q: How quickly can you actually get started?
general.a: Once you select a plan we kick off onboarding within 48 hours: dedicated point of contact assigned, current digital state audited, and a 30/60/90-day roadmap delivered. Active work begins in the same week.

general.q: What makes Wixnova different from other agencies?
general.a: Three things: scope, accountability, and speed. Most agencies specialize in one area and outsource the rest. Wixnova handles everything in-house — design, development, SEO, paid ads, content, and automation — under one subscription with a single point of contact.

general.q: What if I'm not happy with the work?
general.a: Unlimited revisions within scope until you're satisfied — no arguments, no extra charges. Our 98% client satisfaction rate and month-to-month model means we're always incentivized to do great work, not adequate work.

general.q: Do I need to provide content and copy?
general.a: No. On Growth plans and above, our team handles copywriting, content creation, and creative production. We onboard deeply on your brand voice and goals — then we create everything. You review and approve.

general.q: Can I upgrade, downgrade, or pause my plan?
general.a: Yes to all three. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades and pauses apply from your next billing date — just give us notice.

general.q: Do you own the work or do I?
general.a: You own 100% of the final deliverables — source files, design files, code, accounts, and assets — once they're delivered and the invoicing period is paid in full.

general.q: Do you use AI in your workflow?
general.a: Yes — for research, draft acceleration, motion exploration, and analytics. Final craft is always human-led by senior designers, writers, and engineers. We never ship raw generated output.

services.q: What services are included in a subscription?
services.a: Depending on the plan: UI/UX design, brand identity, web design, web and app development, motion and illustration, SEO, paid ads (Meta, Google), content production, email and CRM automation, and analytics dashboards.

services.q: Which tech stacks do you build on?
services.a: Web: React, Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, Webflow, and Shopify. Mobile: React Native and Flutter. Backend: Supabase, Node, and serverless on Cloudflare or Vercel. We pick the stack to fit your team — not the other way around.

services.q: Can you take over an existing website, brand, or codebase?
services.a: Absolutely. We audit what's already shipped, document the gaps, and pick up from where the last team left off — no rebuild unless it's the right call.

services.q: Do you offer SEO and paid media as standalone work?
services.a: Yes. SEO audits, technical SEO, content programs, and paid media (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok) can be bought as one-time engagements or rolled into a Growth subscription.

services.q: Do you handle ongoing maintenance after launch?
services.a: Yes. Subscribers get continuous iteration, A/B testing, content updates, performance fixes, and analytics — not just a one-shot delivery.

contact.q: How fast do you ship the first draft?
contact.a: First drafts on most design tickets land within 48 hours of brief approval. Larger builds (full sites, app flows, brand systems) move through clear milestones inside a 2–6 week window depending on plan.

headline: We don't just build
digital — we build growth.
about.intro: Wixnova is a full-service digital growth partner. Brand, design, development, marketing and automation — one coordinated ecosystem instead of fragmented vendors. Built for serious operators who treat digital as a system, not a side project.
about.founderQuote: If our clients grow, **we grow.** That is not a tagline — it is the **operating system** of everything we do at Wixnova.
story: Wixnova was founded on a simple observation: most businesses engaging digital agencies end up managing fragments — a designer here, a developer there, a marketer somewhere else. The result is misaligned strategy, inconsistent execution and growth that never reaches its full potential.

We built Wixnova to solve that problem entirely. By combining branding, design, development, marketing and automation under one coordinated ecosystem, we give businesses a single growth partner with full accountability across every digital function.

Every service we deliver is designed to create compounding value. The brand we build strengthens the website we develop. The website powers the campaigns we run. The campaigns feed back into the systems we optimise. Nothing operates in isolation.
